0.1.0.en: First release, with the Electricity and Thermostat shortcuts widgets.

0.1.1.en: Widgets now look more like Homey's own, with more compact thermostat buttons. Electricity: the lowest price is shown once when the 12h and 24h lowest are the same hour.

0.1.2.en: Now available in 13 languages. Electricity: smaller chart titles and footer text. Usage chart: a marker at the latest reading.
